description: This file defines the interface for a UCC command string parser within the beerocks namespace, including a pure virtual method for parsing commands from a byte buffer.

classes.name: UccParser
classes.description: An interface class for parsing UCC command strings from byte buffers, designed to be implemented for different socket and message framing protocols.

methods.name: parse_command
methods.description: Parses a UCC command string from a byte buffer, returning true if successful and filling the command string.
